strings.pbx264PresetWarning.ToolTip:
For real time encoding like screen recording it is recommended to select fast as possible preset.
Otherwise it can't keep up with recording and a lot of frame drops will happen.
strings.cbx264Preset.ToolTip:
Faster preset = Faster encoding but higher file size.
Slower preset = Slower encoding but lower file size.
For real time encoding (e.g. screen recording), the preset must be as fast as possible.
strings.nudx264CRF.ToolTip:
Constant Rate Factor (CRF): The value can be between 0-51, where 0 is lossless, 30 is default, and 51 is the worst possible.
A higher value means bad quality, but a low file size.
strings.nudXvidQscale.ToolTip: 1 being highest quality/largest filesize and 31 being the lowest quality/smallest filesize.
strings.nudGIFBayerScale.ToolTip: Controls the Bayer Scale index, a higher scale will display more banding. Default is 2.
